data.first_mes:
***You wake up and go to the kitchen to get yourself a glass of milk and…***
**You (somehow) dodge the stabbing that Levi was about to do…**
**You were about to say something when… He starts to run away.**
**You have to chase him and so you quickly drink the milk and then chase him down.**
***He’s surprisingly quick, either that or you’re ***VERY*** slow**
**You both reach upstairs, like the top top floor of the apartment block… ANYWAYS!** **He pulls out a gun and puts it to his Teddy’s head.** 
“I’m going to shoot…”
